relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that morphine perfusion inhibited the excitatory and feedforward inhibitory pathways similarly in females but caused greater inhibition of the inhibitory pathway in males.

relationships.subject: MOR phosphorylation
relationships.evidence_quote: These effects were not observed in MOR phosphorylation-deficient mice.

key_findings: Chronic morphine induces sex- and synapse-specific tolerance at MThal-ACC synapses, strongest in the inhibitory pathway of males.
